subject.title: refactor(qa): finish Matrix QA Lab ownership

question: After https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103604 and the preceding stack land, should exact head `8f79563535b19c3c87a9c22f41b6ae1a099cdc1a` be authorized to remove the temporary `qa-matrix` workspace package and private runtime facade?
rationale: The implementation is review-clean, but repository policy reserves the lockfile/package removal and permanent compatibility-boundary choice for an authorized human.

options.title: Authorize the cleanup
options.body: Land the prerequisite stack, approve the exact reviewed head, and merge with QA Lab as the single owner.

options.title: Retain the compatibility package
options.body: Keep the temporary package and facade until maintainers identify additional source-checkout consumers or a longer transition requirement.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Hold this PR if the preceding workflow and scenario ownership changes will not land in their reviewed form.

recommendation.title: Authorize the cleanup
recommendation.body: Land the prerequisite stack, approve the exact reviewed head, and merge with QA Lab as the single owner.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available routing candidate across the affected packaging and Plugin SDK boundaries and can coordinate the required authorization.
